figurative_meaning_en: To be in crisis or dire straits
similar_in_english: Up to one's neck in trouble
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসার লোকসানে সে সম্পূর্ণ ডুবা হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The man is drowning in debt.
He is completely sunk due to business losses.
note: Idiom often used in context of debt (দেনায় ডুবা), reflecting economic struggles in Bengali society.
